user_query: I'm planning a surprise birthday party for my best friend and I need your help. Can you suggest some unique party themes? Additionally, recommend a good bakery that can create a customized birthday cake. Moreover, find a venue with a dance floor for the party.

TaskList.description: Research and list unique party themes suitable for a birthday celebration.
Look for a bakery that specializes in customized birthday cakes and has good reviews.
Find venues that have a dance floor suitable for hosting parties.
